hpi: This case illustrates the importance of recognizing the clinical features of systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) in a patient presenting with joint pain and rash. The diagnosis can be challenging due to the variability of symptoms and the need for specific laboratory tests to confirm the diagnosis. Early recognition and appropriate management are crucial to prevent complications associated with SLE.

patient_voice.pain: My joints are aching, especially in my hands and knees.
